summary.text: Trish Carter-Goodheart is the Democratic candidate for the Idaho House of Representatives, District 6A, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Colton Bennett.

paragraphs.text: Trish Carter-Goodheart was the Democratic candidate for Idaho House District 6A in both 2022 and 2024, losing to incumbent Lori McCann (R) in the general elections of November 8, 2022 and November 5, 2024.
